description: Fixed bilingual retrieval corpus for SQLite FTS and optional vector reranking. Labels are evaluation-only; the deterministic embedding port is a simulator, not a production model.

entries.title: Release canary deployment
entries.summary: Deploy a release gradually and keep rollback available.
entries.content: Release deployment starts with a canary, checks health, then expands traffic. 发布部署先灰度，再扩大流量；异常时回滚。

entries.title: Release rollback decision
entries.summary: Rollback the deployment when canary health regresses.
entries.content: A release rollback restores the previous version after a failed canary. 发布回滚恢复上一版本。

entries.title: Deployment health gate
entries.summary: The release gate checks error rate before promotion.
entries.content: Deployment canary health must pass before release traffic increases. 部署灰度健康检查通过后再放量。

entries.title: Release window checklist
entries.summary: Prepare the release window and rollback owner.
entries.content: Release deployment checklist records the canary, approval, and rollback owner. 发布部署清单记录灰度和回滚负责人。

entries.title: Canary deployment observation
entries.summary: Observe canary metrics during a release.
entries.content: Canary deployment compares latency and errors before completing the release. 灰度部署期间比较延迟与错误。

entries.title: SQLite migration schema change
entries.summary: Apply additive SQLite schema migrations.
entries.content: SQLite migration adds a schema table without rewriting existing rows. SQLite 数据库迁移以增量方式调整表结构。

entries.title: Database migration rollback
entries.summary: Validate migration rollback behavior on a copy.
entries.content: A SQLite database migration is checked against the previous schema before deployment. 数据库迁移先验证旧表结构兼容。

entries.title: SQLite migration checksum
entries.summary: Keep migration checksums stable after release.
entries.content: SQLite schema migration checksums detect edits to applied database steps. SQLite 迁移校验和用于发现已应用步骤被改写。

entries.title: Additive schema evolution
entries.summary: Prefer additive database schema evolution.
entries.content: An additive SQLite migration preserves existing tables while introducing a new schema object. 增量迁移保留现有数据库表。

entries.title: Migration prerequisite guard
entries.summary: Fail closed when the prior schema is absent.
entries.content: SQLite migration prerequisites verify the expected database schema before applying DDL. 迁移前检查数据库表结构和前置条件。

entries.title: FTS full-text retrieval
entries.summary: Use FTS for lexical memory retrieval.
entries.content: FTS full-text retrieval ranks keyword matches with BM25. 全文检索按关键词匹配并返回排序。

entries.title: Full-text keyword index
entries.summary: Index memory text for keyword search.
entries.content: The FTS full-text index stores searchable terms for memory recall. 全文索引保存记忆关键词以供检索。

entries.title: BM25 search ranking
entries.summary: Order lexical matches by BM25 rank.
entries.content: FTS keyword retrieval uses BM25 to order full-text search candidates. BM25 对全文关键词结果排序。

entries.title: FTS query neutralization
entries.summary: Neutralize user text before FTS matching.
entries.content: A safe FTS query turns user words into quoted full-text search terms. 全文检索前先安全处理中性化关键词。

entries.title: Lexical memory recall
entries.summary: Keep keyword retrieval as a recall path.
entries.content: Lexical FTS search provides a transparent keyword baseline for memory retrieval. 关键词全文检索作为记忆召回基线。

entries.title: Embedding vector retrieval
entries.summary: Compare embeddings for semantic retrieval.
entries.content: An embedding vector represents memory meaning for semantic similarity search. 嵌入向量表达记忆语义并计算相似度。

entries.title: Semantic similarity score
entries.summary: Rank nearby vectors by cosine similarity.
entries.content: Semantic vector retrieval compares embeddings with cosine similarity. 语义检索使用向量余弦相似度排序。

entries.title: Embedding model version
entries.summary: Key each cached vector by model version.
entries.content: An embedding cache includes model identity and version so changed models rebuild vectors. 嵌入缓存按模型标识和版本更新。

entries.title: Vector cache invalidation
entries.summary: Rebuild vectors when memory content changes.
entries.content: A content hash invalidates a stale semantic vector after an entry edit. 记忆内容变化后按哈希重建向量。

entries.title: Nearest semantic memories
entries.summary: Find meaning-near memory vectors.
entries.content: Semantic embeddings retrieve conceptually similar memories beyond exact keywords. 语义嵌入可召回近义记忆。

entries.title: Memory eligibility filter
entries.summary: Filter entries before any retrieval scoring.
entries.content: Eligibility checks status, workspace scope, expiry, and sensitivity before memory ranking. 记忆排序前先检查状态、范围、到期和敏感级别。

entries.title: Sensitive memory boundary
entries.summary: Restricted text must not reach embeddings.
entries.content: Sensitivity policy excludes restricted memory text before a remote or local embedding call. 敏感记忆在嵌入调用前过滤。

entries.title: Workspace access scope
entries.summary: Keep retrieval within authorized scope.
entries.content: Workspace scope and permissions constrain which memory entries can be searched. 工作区范围和权限限制记忆检索。

entries.title: Privacy-first candidate scoring
entries.summary: Only eligible candidates receive scores.
entries.content: Privacy filtering happens before semantic scores or FTS recall are computed. 隐私过滤先于语义评分和全文召回。

entries.title: Expiry and sensitivity guard
entries.summary: Remove expired or restricted entries from retrieval.
entries.content: Expiry and sensitivity guards prevent ineligible memory text from being embedded. 到期和敏感级别检查阻止不合格内容进入嵌入。

entries.title: Conversation context compaction
entries.summary: Compact old conversation turns into context.
entries.content: Conversation compaction summarizes older turns to fit a context window. 对话压缩把较早轮次归纳进上下文。

entries.title: Conversation summary checkpoint
entries.summary: Preserve a summary during compaction.
entries.content: A conversation summary checkpoint retains decisions when context is compacted. 上下文压缩时保留对话摘要和决定。

entries.title: Context window budget
entries.summary: Reduce conversation context to fit the token budget.
entries.content: Compaction shortens conversation context before the context window is exceeded. 对话摘要压缩避免超出上下文窗口。

entries.title: Summarize prior dialogue
entries.summary: Summarize dialogue without losing decisions.
entries.content: Conversation summarization carries forward key decisions from older messages. 摘要保留较早对话中的关键决定。

entries.title: Compacted conversation recovery
entries.summary: Restore a conversation from compacted context.
entries.content: A compacted conversation uses its summary to continue within the context window. 对话压缩后使用摘要继续交互。

entries.title: Run crash recovery
entries.summary: Recover a run after a process crash.
entries.content: Recovery inspects a checkpoint after a worker crash before resuming the run. 进程崩溃后检查点用于恢复并继续运行。

entries.title: Restart from checkpoint
entries.summary: Resume work from durable progress.
entries.content: A restart resumes the run from its latest recovery checkpoint. 重启后从最新检查点恢复。

entries.title: Process failure recovery
entries.summary: Classify a failed process before resuming.
entries.content: Process recovery distinguishes a crash from a live run before restart. 进程恢复先判断崩溃状态再重启。

entries.title: Resume interrupted execution
entries.summary: Continue an interrupted execution safely.
entries.content: A recovery record identifies whether interrupted execution can resume. 恢复记录判断中断任务是否能够继续。

entries.title: Checkpoint recovery record
entries.summary: Persist facts needed for restart recovery.
entries.content: Recovery checkpoints preserve run identity and progress across process restart. 检查点保存运行身份和进度以便恢复。

entries.title: Workflow approval gate
entries.summary: Require approval before a protected action.
entries.content: A workflow approval gate blocks execution until an authorized reviewer approves. 工作流审批门禁等待授权审核人批准。

entries.title: Approval decision record
entries.summary: Persist who approved a workflow step.
entries.content: An approval decision records authorization before the workflow continues. 审批决定记录授权后工作流继续。

entries.title: Authorized workflow transition
entries.summary: Advance only after explicit authorization.
entries.content: Workflow transition requires an explicit approve action at the gate. 工作流状态变更需要明确批准。

entries.title: Reviewer approval handoff
entries.summary: Route a protected step to its reviewer.
entries.content: The approval workflow sends a review request to an authorized owner. 审批工作流将审核请求发送给负责人。

entries.title: Approval request lifecycle
entries.summary: Track an approval request through its workflow.
entries.content: An approval request remains pending until the workflow receives authorization. 审批请求在收到授权前保持等待。

entries.title: Browser end-to-end QA
entries.summary: Verify user journeys in a real browser.
entries.content: Browser end-to-end QA checks page interaction and visible outcomes. 浏览器端到端测试检查页面交互和可见结果。

entries.title: Playwright DOM assertion
entries.summary: Assert current DOM state after interaction.
entries.content: Playwright browser checks refresh the DOM before selecting controls. Playwright 浏览器测试在交互后读取当前页面结构。

entries.title: Visual browser regression
entries.summary: Catch layout changes in browser QA.
entries.content: Visual browser QA compares the rendered page after a user action. 浏览器视觉回归检查操作后的页面布局。

entries.title: End-to-end page interaction
entries.summary: Exercise navigation and forms in a browser.
entries.content: An end-to-end browser test follows navigation and submits a page form. 端到端浏览器测试覆盖导航和表单提交。

entries.title: Browser accessibility state
entries.summary: Read accessible controls after page updates.
entries.content: Browser QA refreshes accessible names when the DOM changes. 页面 DOM 更新后重新读取浏览器可访问名称。

entries.title: Windows child process tree
entries.summary: Track descendants started by a Windows worker.
entries.content: Windows process ownership records the child process tree for cleanup. Windows 进程树跟踪工作进程启动的子进程。

entries.title: Windows Job Object cleanup
entries.summary: Terminate owned descendants through a Job Object.
entries.content: A Windows Job Object groups child processes and supports reliable termination. Windows 任务对象管理并清理子进程。

entries.title: Child process termination
entries.summary: Stop the full process tree on cancellation.
entries.content: Windows cancellation terminates the owned process tree, not just its parent. Windows 取消时终止完整子进程树。

entries.title: Windows process birth identity
entries.summary: Distinguish a process from a reused PID.
entries.content: Windows process identity includes birth facts to avoid acting on a recycled PID. Windows 进程身份使用创建信息避免 PID 复用误判。

entries.title: Owned process shutdown
entries.summary: Shut down owned child processes deterministically.
entries.content: Process tree ownership makes Windows worker shutdown deterministic. Windows 工作进程通过进程树所有权完成清理。

entries.title: Provider model routing
entries.summary: Route a request to its configured provider.
entries.content: Provider routing selects a model endpoint from workspace configuration. 供应商路由按工作区配置选择模型端点。

entries.title: LLM endpoint fallback
entries.summary: Fallback to an approved model endpoint.
entries.content: Provider fallback uses a configured endpoint when the primary model is unavailable. 主模型不可用时供应商使用已配置端点降级。

entries.title: Provider configuration boundary
entries.summary: Keep model credentials in provider settings.
entries.content: Provider configuration binds credentials and model routing to a workspace. 供应商配置将凭据与模型路由绑定到工作区。

entries.title: Model endpoint selection
entries.summary: Choose the endpoint for a model call.
entries.content: The model router selects a provider endpoint and records its identity. 模型路由器选择供应商端点并记录身份。

entries.title: Provider failover result
entries.summary: Report the provider selected after failover.
entries.content: Provider failover reports whether a backup model endpoint handled the request. 供应商故障切换记录备用模型端点结果。

entries.title: Rate limit retry backoff
entries.summary: Back off when an upstream quota is reached.
entries.content: Rate limit handling retries after exponential backoff when quota is exhausted. 配额触顶后限流逻辑退避并重试。

entries.title: Quota aware retry policy
entries.summary: Respect quota reset before retrying.
entries.content: A quota-aware retry waits for the reset window before another request. 配额重试等待重置窗口后再发送请求。

entries.title: Throttling backoff schedule
entries.summary: Increase delay after repeated throttling.
entries.content: Throttling uses backoff delays to reduce repeated rate limit responses. 限流通过退避间隔减少连续拒绝。

entries.title: Retry after capacity response
entries.summary: Parse retry timing from a capacity response.
entries.content: A rate limit response can specify when the client should retry. 限流响应可告知客户端何时重试。

entries.title: Bounded retry exhaustion
entries.summary: Stop retrying after the configured attempt limit.
entries.content: A bounded retry policy exits after repeated quota and rate limit failures. 多次配额限流失败后停止重试。

entries.title: Conversation file attachment
entries.summary: Persist metadata for an attached file.
entries.content: A conversation attachment records file identity, MIME type, and storage reference. 对话附件保存文件身份、内容类型和存储引用。

entries.title: Artifact upload reference
entries.summary: Link an uploaded artifact to its run.
entries.content: An artifact reference binds an uploaded file to the producing run. 上传工件引用关联产生它的运行。

entries.title: Attachment content type
entries.summary: Validate the MIME type of an attachment.
entries.content: Attachment handling checks file content type before exposing a download. 附件读取前检查文件内容类型。

entries.title: File artifact lifecycle
entries.summary: Track a file artifact through completion.
entries.content: A file artifact keeps its storage key and completion provenance. 文件工件记录存储键和完成来源。

entries.title: Download attached evidence
entries.summary: Retrieve evidence linked as an attachment.
entries.content: An attachment can point to review evidence without copying the full file into a message. 附件可引用评审证据而不复制全文。

entries.title: Workspace task scope
entries.summary: Keep task memory in its workspace boundary.
entries.content: Task scope and workspace ownership isolate memory between tenants. 任务范围和工作区归属隔离不同租户的记忆。

entries.title: Task ownership isolation
entries.summary: Resolve entries only for the owning task.
entries.content: Task ownership limits memory access to the correct workspace and owner. 任务归属将记忆限制在正确工作区和负责人。

entries.title: Tenant workspace boundary
entries.summary: Prevent cross-workspace memory retrieval.
entries.content: Workspace boundaries prevent a tenant from retrieving another tenant's task facts. 工作区边界阻止跨租户任务信息检索。

entries.title: Scoped task context
entries.summary: Build context from the current task scope.
entries.content: A scoped task context includes only entries reachable from its workspace. 任务上下文只包含工作区范围内可达的记忆。

entries.title: Workspace ownership check
entries.summary: Verify workspace ownership before retrieval.
entries.content: Workspace ownership is checked before task-scoped memory lookup. 工作区记忆检索前先确认任务范围和归属。

entries.title: Memory expiry lifecycle
entries.summary: Expire an entry when its validity window ends.
entries.content: Memory expiry removes an entry from retrieval after its expiration time. 记忆到期后从检索候选中排除。

entries.title: Retention and archive policy
entries.summary: Archive low-value facts under retention policy.
entries.content: A retention policy archives facts after their useful period ends. 保留策略在信息失效后归档低价值事实。

entries.title: Expiration timestamp check
entries.summary: Compare expiry timestamps before use.
entries.content: An expiration timestamp determines whether a memory remains valid. 到期时间戳决定记忆是否仍有效。

entries.title: Memory archival decision
entries.summary: Archive a fact without deleting its history.
entries.content: Archival changes memory lifecycle state while preserving its audit history. 归档更新记忆状态并保留审计历史。

entries.title: TTL based memory retention
entries.summary: Use TTL to bound memory retention.
entries.content: A TTL retention window expires old memory before another retrieval. TTL 保留期限制旧记忆并使其到期。

entries.title: Collaboration candidate review
entries.summary: Review a candidate before applying it.
entries.content: Collaboration review evaluates a candidate using evidence before application. 协作评审在应用候选前检查证据。

entries.title: Multi-agent evidence record
entries.summary: Keep evidence from each participating agent.
entries.content: Multi-agent collaboration preserves candidate evidence and reviewer decisions. 多智能体协作保留候选证据和评审决定。

entries.title: Candidate acceptance decision
entries.summary: Accept a candidate only after review.
entries.content: A collaboration candidate moves to accepted after evidence-based review. 协作候选经证据评审后才能接受。

entries.title: Review evidence provenance
entries.summary: Trace review evidence to its source.
entries.content: Review provenance links a collaboration decision to source evidence. 评审来源将协作决定关联到原始证据。

entries.title: Collaborative application gate
entries.summary: Apply reviewed work after an explicit decision.
entries.content: Collaboration control requires a review decision before candidate application. 协作候选应用前需要明确评审决定。
